Function imports only standard dependencies in its actual setup; Bounds requires its own qualified Function provider. A dependency object without its independent provider cannot be substituted.

The fixed full Tail receipt supplies object and import-byte identities. Tail's stock result remains dependency context and is not relabeled as either prerequisite's own source exit or direct stock result.
The two original source events do not record exit codes. The new evidence describes guarded invocation plus completed bound outputs and explicitly sets source_exit_code_recorded=false.

All eleven historical runtime payload entries must match files in the verified base and their actual physical hashes. The focused tests reject a changed non-Lean payload and a payload absent from the qualified base.

The unchanged final consumer and namespace checks remain the publication gate. Original checkpoint classifications, the old Winner9 snapshot and donor files are not upgraded or modified; no new source compilation or kernel credit is granted.
